caption: בבל, המלכה הגדולה שבצפון

caption: אדום, צאצאי עשו

en: ancient pyramids beside a wide river with palm trees, no people, no text (Egypt, land of the Nile)

caption: בואו נעזר להם
en: ancient men in robes carrying baskets and tools walking toward a ruined hill town to help, no text (Let us help them)

en: a group of ancient men in robes on a hill laughing and pointing at empty ruined terraces below, small figures, no text (Aha, it is ours)

en: a group of ancient men in robes standing with heads bowed in embarrassment on a hill, no text (They will carry their shame)

caption: יהיו מאשרים מאד

en: a bearded prophet in a white turban speaking to a flock of sheep in a field, no text (To the sheep in the fields)

caption: אל העננים בשמים
en: a bearded prophet in a white turban gazing up and speaking toward big white clouds in a blue sky, no text (To the clouds in the sky)

en: a bearded prophet in a white turban (Ezekiel) standing on a hill and speaking with an outstretched arm toward the green mountains around him, no text (To the mountains themselves)
